error[ZC-E0126]: a service's rollout policy is not valid
  cause  rollout.max_surge and rollout.max_unavailable are both 0, so nothing
         can move
  fix    correct the service file and apply it again
  more   zcube explain E0126 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0126.html
